architecture.owner: one continuous GPT Sol Max session
forbidden: LLM calls inside deterministic inner loops

authorities.exclusionRule: The 504 issue-519 identities and the three readout classes named by the issue-521 quarantine are forbidden from selection, fitting, threshold choice and confirmatory inference.

issue521Audit.policies: exact issue-520 v3 sixteen-policy cohort plus RandomBuild and RandomPlay controls
issue521Audit.split: Sort the sixteen semantic policy hashes; even positions are discovery and odd positions are held-out. Even seeds are discovery and odd seeds are held-out. Controls are reported separately and never fitted.

stageA.purpose: Audit the exact issue-521 candidates without treating their labels as causal truth.
stageA.instrumentationRule: Observational counters may append to simulator output but may not change choices, card order, RNG calls, RunState cursor or outcomeDigest.
stageA.exactReplayRule: Every new instrumented row must reproduce the issue-521 matched candidate outcomeDigest for the same candidate, policy, grid and seed, except the quarantined full-catalogue baseline comparison is not used.

interventionRelevance.bootstrap: paired policy-seed-grid bootstrap p05 must exceed zero in discovery and held-out splits

armSpecificity.selectiveRandomBuild: Target acquisition must rise by at least 0.20 in RandomBuild, by at most 0.05 in planned policies, RandomBuild win delta must be at most -0.15, and planned global-mean win delta must be at least -0.10.
armSpecificity.routeClaim: The claimed package must increase held-out acquisition and activation in planned policies by at least 0.05 and 0.25 standard deviations more than in RandomBuild.

stageA.decision: Cards or old package labels failing any relevance, exclusion, arm-specificity or held-out check are not detector ground truth and are retained only as audited historical interventions.

stageB.authoredView: All 61 cards, upgrades and 31 relics; aspect, rarity, cost, target, reveal reachability and authored effect producers/consumers. Outcomes are excluded from this view.
stageB.candidateEdgeRule: Test authored producer-consumer, shared-resource, trigger, saturation and antagonism hypotheses; do not enumerate unsupported all-pairs.

interactionAdmission.bootstrap: paired p05 above zero for complementarity or p95 below zero for antagonism on both discovery and held-out contexts
interactionAdmission.baseline: hierarchical ridge interaction model plus exact pairwise Shapley-Taylor difference-in-differences; ExtraTrees fANOVA must agree in sign for promoted edges

stageB.utilityHubRule: A card or relic with positive main effects in both aspects and positive links to at least half of admitted packages is a generic utility hub and cannot define a route.
stageB.stop: If fewer than three separated packages, or fewer than two reachable packages in either aspect, pass held-out activation, reachability and stall-free viability, return the exact missing mechanism/package finding before Stage C.

stageC.method: Constrained Gaussian-process or monotone Bayesian root-finding with common random numbers; transparent grid/bisection is the baseline.
stageC.reproducibility: All seven directions and nuisance matches must retain sign and tolerance under independent policies and mutationValidationSeeds.
stageC.stop: If breadth cannot be isolated from global power, reliability or arm effects, stop without fitting detector thresholds.

stageD.detector: exact functional-policy kernel with quality-weighted Vendi or effective-rank breadth, dominance concentration, distinct-policy regret and local-search retention
stageD.stop: Failure blocks every Stage E or F row and no successor is created.

context: acquisition decline removal and upgrade history
stageE.admission: A contextual family must improve held-out detector utility by at least 0.02 relative and long-horizon win-or-breadth value by at least 0.02 absolute with paired bootstrap p05 above zero, while every hard guardrail passes.
stageE.escalation: Functional causal BO, contextual bandits or SlateQ require a held-out residual value gap of at least 0.02 after the simpler families.

stageF.effectivePolicyDimensionAuthority: issue-520 effective joint dimension 28, active-subspace rank 8 and coverage-complete 44-control policy instrument
stageF.shippingLeverAuthority: issue-520 inventory of 726 numeric shipping levers and 205 diagnostic structural levers
stageF.roundAdmission: Continue only for at least 0.02 relative archive-area progress, at least 0.01 nat information gain per registered row, a 0.20-0.80 feasibility decision, or a uniquely viable policy.
stageF.stop: Three no-progress rounds, lower value of information than measured cost, or likely hard-guard regression.
